run_train_controlnet_sd3: run the SD3 ControlNet training script with pretrained model, dataset, and output directory arguments
parse_args_controlnet_training: parse command-line arguments for SD3 ControlNet training including dataset, learning rate, and validation settings
encode_prompt_sd3: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders into prompt embeddings and pooled embeddings for SD3
log_validation_sd3_controlnet: run validation with SD3 ControlNet pipeline and log generated images to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card_sd3: generate and save a model card README with example images and licensing information for the trained controlnet
